messages.content:
Research and compare routes for systematically learning entrepreneurship and preparing to launch a startup over the next 1–2 years.

Compare degree and non-degree programs, executive education, accelerators, online courses, mentoring and networking routes, and practical venture-building options. Cover curriculum, time commitment, cost, mentor and network access, hands-on opportunities, fundraising, business-model, product, market and team-management learning, and the value of each route.

Produce a phased 1–2 year learning and experimentation plan.

Available user profile context (incomplete):
- [IDENTITY / EDUCATION / CAREER] MBA from Shanghai Jiao Tong University, specializing in marketing and business management.
- [IDENTITY / EDUCATION / CAREER] Values family and career development; good at combining Eastern/Western thinking.
- [FAMILY] Daughter, age 8: likes painting/dance.
- [FAMILY] Family has a yellow Labrador, Xiao Huang.
- [FAMILY] Harmonious household emphasizing communication and mutual growth.
- [FAMILY] Liu is primary breadwinner; wife focuses more on children's education/household.
- [LIVING / LOCATION] Lives in Pudong, Shanghai, in a high-end community with schools, malls and parks.
- [LIVING / LOCATION] Shanghai + Suzhou background shaped pragmatism and attention to quality of life.
- [DIGITAL / PROFESSIONAL BEHAVIOR] Uses Zhihu and Dedao for industry knowledge.
- [DIGITAL / PROFESSIONAL BEHAVIOR] Focuses on market trends and innovative management models.
- [ROUTINE / TIME] Fixed monthly household budget.
- [ROUTINE / TIME] Family trips periodically.
- [ROUTINE / TIME] High-efficiency work in mornings; meetings/team communication afternoons; evenings reading/project planning.
- [PERSONALITY / DECISION STYLE] Pragmatic, rational, detail-oriented and efficiency-focused.
- [PERSONALITY / DECISION STYLE] Family issues decided together with wife.
- [CONSUMPTION] Prefers durable, higher-end household goods when worthwhile.
- [CONSUMPTION] Will spend meaningfully on children's education.
- [TRAVEL] Family-oriented trips.
- [TRAVEL] Self-guided; likes planning.
- [TRAVEL] Values deeper experiences and family interaction.
- [CONTENT] Reads management/business material and case studies, including Harvard Business Review-type content.
- [CONTENT] Interested in market trends, innovative management and business cases.
- [FINANCE / RISK] Invests in stocks/funds.
- [FINANCE / RISK] Risk-conscious and attentive to risk-return balance.
